title: Rushdawn Station
summary: The first light of day bounces off the Rushden Station rental towers beside Danforth GO station in Toronto's East End. Closing in on completion, each of the three towers sports a different colour of cladding panels; green, red, and blue, while the podium sports fins in a variety of colours. Much of that differentiation is lost in the high contrast dawn light, but the red tower still manages to stake a claim for local landmark status.
